resources.string: Lets Garad read what is on your screen when you ask it to.

Garad agent reads the text and buttons on your screen only when you ask Garad Voice for help, so it can describe the screen and, in a later update, help you act in apps with your spoken confirmation. It never reads password fields and does not work in banking or mobile-money apps. You can turn it off here or in the Garad AI app at any time.
